title: TernaryLLM: Ternarized Large Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2406.07177v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, but they are hindered by high computational costs and memory requirements. Ternarization, an extreme form of quantization, offers a solution by reducing memory usage and enabling energy-efficient floating-point additions. However, applying ternarization to LLMs faces challenges stemming from outliers in both weights and activations. In this work, observing asymmetric outliers and non-zero means in weights, we introduce Dual Learnable Ternarization (DLT), which enables both scales and shifts to be learnable. We also propose Outlier-Friendly Feature Knowledge Distillation (OFF) to recover the information lost in extremely low-bit quantization. translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言处理（NLP）任务上取得了卓越的性能，但其高昂的计算成本和内存需求制约了其发展。三值化作为一种极端形式的量化，通过减少内存占用并支持高能效的浮点加法运算，提供了一种解决方案。然而，将三值化应用于大语言模型时，会面临权重和激活值中离群值带来的挑战。在本工作中，通过观察权重中不对称的离群值和非零均值现象，我们提出了双重可学习三值化（Dual Learnable Ternarization, DLT），使尺度和偏移参数均可学习。我们还提出了对离群值友好的特征知识蒸馏（Outlier-Friendly Feature Knowledge Distillation, OFF），以恢复极低位宽量化中丢失的信息。所提出的OFF能够融入语义信息，且对离群值不敏感。OFF的核心在于最大化三值化模型与浮点模型中特征之间的互信息。
tldr: 本文提出TernaryLLM，通过双重可学习三值化（DLT）和对离群值友好的特征知识蒸馏（OFF）两项创新技术，克服了权重与激活中离群值的挑战，实现了大语言模型的高效三值化，从而大幅降低计算成本和内存需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TernaryLLM, which achieves efficient ternarization of large language models through Dual Learnable Ternarization (DLT) and Outlier-Friendly Feature Knowledge Distillation (OFF), overcoming outlier challenges in weights and activations to drastically reduce computational costs and memory requirements.
